digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup binding & auth
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture deployment/startup config exactly once at service initialization and compose a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot for each operation/request without re-reading ambient material
Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain transient request context via PROXY_IDENTITY ContextVar, never enter startup/operation snapshots, logs, caches, or serialization

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit token, GitHub auth) before accepting work, forward the composed LLMRuntime through the operation, and never fall back to an alternative principal on auth failure
Static binding changes (env/file mutation) must not rebind a running process; only a restarted process observes rotated material; SDK-owned refreshable capabilities remain SDK-controlled
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable telemetry as fail-open/no-op without changing the underlying operation result
Security-critical auth (decision-bearing, inbound tokens) must remain fail-closed; telemetry failures must not affect operation correctness or result
